title: FogROS2: An Adaptive Platform for Cloud and Fog Robotics Using ROS 2
reported_metric: grasp planning 14 s -> 1.2 s; motion planning 45x faster; 97% lower image RTT vs FogROS1
tldr: Open-source ROS 2 framework that launches selected unmodified ROS 2 nodes on cloud machines with secure networking and compressed image transport, letting low-compute robots offload SLAM, grasp and motion planning.
relevance_reason: Seed system for cloud/fog robotics offloading; basis of many later remote-inference robot works.

title: FogROS2-FT: Fault Tolerant Cloud Robotics
reported_metric: up to 2.2x cost reduction and 5.53x lower P99 latency for motion planning
tldr: Replicates stateless robot services across several clouds and takes the first reply, so robots keep working through provider outages or bad QoS and can safely use cheap spot instances.
relevance_reason: Addresses cloud-robot reliability, tail latency and cost, central to cloud-hosted foundation-model policies.

title: FogROS2-Config: Optimizing Latency and Cost for Multi-Cloud Robot Applications
reported_metric: up to 20x cost reduction
tldr: Toolkit that benchmarks ROS 2 nodes on a small sample of cloud server types to present a latency-vs-cost menu, helping choose cost-efficient offload hardware.
relevance_reason: Directly on cost/latency trade-off (TCO) of cloud robot compute.

title: FogROS2-SGC: A ROS2 Cloud Robotics Platform for Secure Global Connectivity
hardware: 4 robots and compute nodes up to 3600 km apart
reported_metric: 19x faster than rosbridge
tldr: Extends FogROS2 with secure, globally addressable routing so robots and cloud compute across different networks can exchange ROS 2 topics without code changes.
relevance_reason: Networking infrastructure for robot-cloud offloading; less about model efficiency.

title: FogROS G: Enabling Secure, Connected and Mobile Fog Robotics with Global Addressability
tldr: Secure routing layer giving fog robots persistent global names so they can roam across networks while offloading workloads to edge and cloud.
relevance_reason: Early FogROS networking layer; infrastructure only.

title: RoboECC: Multi-Factor-Aware Edge-Cloud Collaborative Deployment for VLA Models
reported_metric: up to 3.28x speedup with 2.55-2.62% overhead
tldr: Finds a model- and hardware-aware split point for VLAs between edge and cloud, then moves it online as bandwidth changes to keep latency low.
relevance_reason: Seed edge-cloud split-computing framework specifically for VLAs.

title: RAPID: Redundancy-Aware and Compatibility-Optimal Edge-Cloud Partitioned Inference for Diverse VLA Models
reported_metric: up to 1.73x speedup with 5-7% overhead
tldr: Edge-cloud partitioned VLA inference that avoids visual-noise-sensitive partitioning and exploits step-to-step redundancy in embodied tasks to decide what runs where.
relevance_reason: Edge-cloud VLA partitioning method from same group as RoboECC.

title: Latency-Tolerant Cloud-Edge Collaborative Vision-Language-Action Models via Emergent Representational Specialization
reported_metric: 63.8-78.0% success with 40-step uniform delay window (VLASH <=6.4%)
tldr: CloudEdgeVLA trains a cloud VLA to emit slowly varying task features from delayed frames while a light edge head fuses the latest feature with current vision, keeping control robust to network delay.
relevance_reason: Directly tackles latency-tolerant cloud/edge split of VLA policies.

title: VLA-ULAP: Interleaving Cloud VLA Calls with Ultra-Lightweight Local Action Prediction at the Edge
reported_metric: ULAP 20.7 ms and 0.122 J per inference on Jetson Orin Nano vs 289.3 ms / 40.46 J for GR00T on RTX A6000; 45-77% of VLA calls removed
tldr: Alternates expensive remote VLA calls with a tiny onboard action predictor that extends chunks from recent views and actions, cutting server calls, latency and onboard energy.
relevance_reason: Explicit remote-vs-onboard co-design with latency and energy measurements.

title: Jetson-PI: Towards Onboard Real-Time Robot Control via Foresight-Aligned Asynchronous Inference
reported_metric: 8.66x / 5.41x control-frequency gain vs naive PyTorch / vla.cpp; +14.8% success over VLASH on LIBERO
tldr: Makes asynchronous VLA inference work onboard Jetson by predicting the future scene given committed actions and adaptively scheduling VLM vs action-expert calls, plus low-level engine optimizations.
relevance_reason: Onboard alternative to cloud offloading; asynchronous inference is a core C6 theme.

title: Communication-Aware Robot Execution for Cloud Inference under Spatially Heterogeneous Connectivity
tldr: Treats where the robot submits its next cloud request as a motion decision, planning toward spots with good wireless coverage so the next cloud result arrives before the current primitive runs out.
relevance_reason: Network-aware execution for cloud-hosted foundation-model robots.

title: COHORT: Hybrid RL for Collaborative Large DNN Inference on Multi-Robot Systems Under Real-Time Constraints
reported_metric: 15.4% lower battery use, 51.67% higher GPU utilization
tldr: Schedules modules of large vision-language models across a team of robots using offline RL then online MAPPO fine-tuning, meeting deadlines without server support.
relevance_reason: Fleet-level distributed inference for large models on robots (not VLA).

title: EcoVLA: Energy-Efficient Device-Edge Co-Inference for Vision-Language-Action Models under Real-Time Constraints
reported_metric: up to 236% energy efficiency gain under 20 Hz action output constraint
tldr: Architecture-agnostic device-edge co-inference for VLAs that picks the most energy-efficient split scheme meeting a real-time deadline and adapts to network and load changes.
relevance_reason: Direct device-edge VLA co-inference with energy and deadline objectives.

title: Efficient Vision-Language-Action Management and Serving for Robot Factories
reported_metric: up to 64 robots served on 4-GPU server within 98% SLO attainment; 6.7x higher robot load than vLLM-Omni
tldr: Robion serves many robots' VLA requests on shared edge GPUs by co-scheduling VLM and action-diffusion stages on separate streams and placing models to meet per-request latency SLOs.
relevance_reason: Fleet-scale VLA serving system for robot factories.

title: Characterizing VLA Models: Identifying the Action Generation Bottleneck for Edge AI Architectures
reported_metric: action generation up to 75% of end-to-end latency
tldr: Profiles a 7B VLA on Jetson Orin and Thor, showing memory-bound action generation dominates latency, and projects hardware needs for much larger onboard models.
relevance_reason: Onboard-vs-cloud feasibility analysis; mainly hardware (C8).

title: EdgeVLA: Efficient Vision-Language-Action Models
reported_metric: 7x inference speedup from removing autoregression
tldr: Edge-oriented VLA that predicts end-effector pose in one pass with a small language model backbone, trading autoregressive decoding for speed on low-power devices.
relevance_reason: Seed 'EdgeVLA' verified; onboard efficiency rather than edge-cloud split.

title: SmolVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model for Affordable and Efficient Robotics
hardware: consumer GPUs / CPU; remote GPU server for async stack
reported_metric: async inference ~30% faster task completion vs synchronous (per Hugging Face)
tldr: Compact VLA plus an asynchronous client/server stack that lets a robot keep executing its action queue while a (possibly remote) policy server computes the next chunk.
relevance_reason: Seed work: open reference implementation of asynchronous remote VLA inference.

title: LeRobot: An Open-Source Library for End-to-End Robot Learning
tldr: Paper describing the LeRobot library spanning motor middleware, datasets, policy implementations and a general asynchronous (remote) inference stack.
relevance_reason: Standard tool providing robot-client/policy-server async inference.

title: FASTER: Rethinking Real-Time Flow VLAs
reported_metric: immediate-reaction denoising compressed ~10x into a single step
tldr: Analyzes reaction latency of chunked flow VLAs and front-loads denoising of near-term actions, streamed from server to robot, so robots can respond to changes much faster.
relevance_reason: Client-server streaming and reaction-latency analysis for remote VLA inference.

title: FluxVLA Engine: A One-Stop VLA Engineering Platform for Embodied Intelligence
tldr: Configuration-driven platform linking data, training, simulation and deployment of VLAs, including RTC with accelerated backends and lightweight remote GPU serving to robots.
relevance_reason: Deployment tooling including remote serving.

title: Real-Time Execution of Action Chunking Flow Policies
tldr: Generates the next action chunk while the current one executes by freezing actions that will surely run and inpainting the rest, making flow VLAs robust to large inference delays such as remote inference.
relevance_reason: Core latency-hiding method used by remote/async VLA deployments.

title: RoboOS: A Hierarchical Embodied Framework for Cross-Embodiment and Multi-Agent Collaboration
tldr: Hierarchical embodied OS where a cloud-hosted multimodal brain plans for multiple robots while onboard skill libraries execute, with edge-cloud communication and distributed inference for scalability.
relevance_reason: Hierarchical onboard/cloud architecture for multi-robot fleets.

title: Gemini Robotics: Bringing AI into the Physical World
reported_metric: backbone query-to-response <160 ms; ~250 ms end-to-end; 50 Hz effective control via chunks
tldr: Gemini Robotics runs a large VLA backbone in the cloud and a small action decoder on the robot, reaching ~250 ms observation-to-action latency with chunked 50 Hz control.
relevance_reason: Canonical split cloud-backbone/onboard-decoder VLA with reported latency.

title: Gemini Robotics On-Device brings AI to local robotic devices
hardware: onboard robot compute (ALOHA, Franka FR3, Apptronik Apollo)
tldr: DeepMind's local VLA variant that runs without network on bi-arm robots, approaching the cloud flagship's generalization and adaptable with 50-100 demos; the explicit onboard counterpart to cloud Gemini Robotics.
relevance_reason: Seed: industry onboard-vs-cloud policy comparison.

title: openpi: Remote inference (policy server over WebSocket)
tldr: openpi's standard deployment path serves pi0-family policies from a GPU server over WebSocket; robots send resized images/state and receive action chunks, querying only every N steps.
relevance_reason: Seed: de facto remote-inference pattern for open VLAs.

title: Speculative Policy Orchestration: A Latency-Resilient Framework for Cloud-Robotic Manipulation
reported_metric: >60% less network-induced idle time vs blocking remote inference
tldr: A cloud world model streams predicted future waypoints into an edge buffer, while an edge verifier bounds execution error and the prefetch horizon adapts to tracking error, decoupling control rate from round-trip time.
relevance_reason: Latency-resilient cloud-edge control scheme for manipulation.

title: Can the Cloud Drive? Infrastructure Feasibility of Offloading Autonomous Driving Across 5G and 6G
reported_metric: autoregressive FP16 VLA decode ~114 ms on 2025 hardware; onboard VLA baseline up to $8,500 per vehicle-year
tldr: Analytical study coupling cellular uplink limits, GPU roofline service and utilization-aware cost to determine when cloud offload of driving VLAs meets reactive/deliberative latency budgets and becomes cheaper than onboard compute.
relevance_reason: Rare explicit TCO + network feasibility analysis for offloaded VLA inference (driving domain).

title: Offload or Overload: A Platform Measurement Study of Mobile Robotic Manipulation Workloads
reported_metric: lossless multi-camera streaming needs ~100 Mbps uplink (per paper)
tldr: First measurement study of mobile manipulation foundation-model stacks across onboard, edge and cloud GPUs, quantifying battery drain, latency-induced accuracy loss, bandwidth needs and fleet compute sharing.
relevance_reason: Empirical ground truth for onboard-vs-offload trade-offs (Microsoft Research).

title: Edge Computing and its Application in Robotics: A Survey
tldr: Survey of edge computing for robotics covering motivations, applications, offloading approaches and open challenges for latency-critical robot workloads.
relevance_reason: Recent survey anchoring edge/fog robotics literature.

title: Vision-Language Models on the Edge for Real-Time Robotic Perception
hardware: MEC edge node vs cloud; Unitree G1
reported_metric: edge 5% lower end-to-end latency than cloud for 11B VLM
tldr: Streams humanoid sensor data over WebRTC to an ORAN/MEC edge node and compares edge vs cloud VLM deployment, finding edge keeps accuracy with modestly lower latency and small models halve latency at an accuracy cost.
relevance_reason: Edge vs cloud VLM for robot perception over mobile networks.

title: Knowledge-Based Ultra-Low-Latency Semantic Communications for Robotic Edge Intelligence
tldr: Air-interface protocol where an edge-server knowledge graph acts as a remote brain; robots upload features over short uncoded packets, exploiting classifier margin to tolerate bit errors for low latency.
relevance_reason: Split inference/communication for robotic edge intelligence; not policy models.

title: VLASH: Real-Time VLAs via Future-State-Aware Asynchronous Inference
reported_metric: up to 11.8x lower reaction latency vs synchronous; 1.5-2.0x task completion speedup with action quantization
tldr: Conditions the VLA on the robot state rolled forward through the already-committed chunk, fixing prediction/execution misalignment in asynchronous inference at zero runtime cost.
relevance_reason: Key asynchronous-inference method, the main latency-hiding tool for remote/offboard VLA serving.

title: Understanding Asynchronous Inference Methods for Vision-Language-Action Models
tldr: Controlled comparison of four asynchronous-inference fixes (inference-time RTC, training-time RTC, VLASH, A2C2) under delays up to 20 steps; residual correction and training-time RTC are most robust.
relevance_reason: Benchmarks delay-robustness methods relevant to remote inference.

title: DEFLECT: Temporal Counterfactual Preference Learning for Delay-Robust Asynchronous VLAs
reported_metric: up to +6.4 pp high-latency success
tldr: Offline post-training that prefers chunks computed from execution-time observations over stale ones, making asynchronous VLAs more robust to inference delay without runtime cost.
relevance_reason: Delay-robust async inference; enabling technique for high-latency (remote) serving.

title: RAVEL: Asynchronous Rolling Inference for Flow-Based Vision-Language-Action Models
tldr: Decouples slow VLM encoding from a continuously running action expert that rolls partially denoised future actions forward, with a fast pathway feeding current observations.
relevance_reason: Hierarchical slow/fast async design applicable to cloud/edge split.

title: FlashVLA: Streaming Action Decoding for Fast and Asynchronous VLA Inference
reported_metric: >=30 Hz control frequency
tldr: Keeps several action chunks at different noise levels in a buffer so every inference step emits an executable chunk, yielding smooth asynchronous execution.
relevance_reason: Async inference technique (MIT Han Lab).

title: FutureRTC: Real-Time Robot Execution with Anticipatory-Conditioned Action Chunking
tldr: Plug-in module predicting execution-time visual features and states so asynchronous VLA chunks align with where the robot will actually be.
relevance_reason: Async-inference misalignment fix.

title: ROSA: A Robotics Foundation Model Serving System for Robot Factories
reported_metric: up to 12.06x factory productivity vs dedicated serving
tldr: Serving system (NVIDIA et al.) where a fleet of factory robots shares a networked GPU pool, scheduled to maximize SLO-qualified factory throughput rather than single-request latency.
relevance_reason: Fleet-scale RFM serving with explicit capital-cost/utilization motivation.

title: DeepFleet: Multi-Agent Foundation Models for Mobile Robots
tldr: Amazon foundation models trained on movement logs of hundreds of thousands of warehouse robots to predict and coordinate fleet behavior.
relevance_reason: Fleet-level foundation model, not about inference efficiency.

title: Action Chunk Scheduling for Batched Robot Policy Serving
reported_metric: up to 18% throughput gain in real-world experiments
tldr: Armory serves one policy to many robots from a remote GPU and schedules batches according to how fast each robot consumes its action chunks.
relevance_reason: Formalizes multi-robot remote VLA serving as a scheduling problem.

title: FogROS2-PLR: Probabilistic Latency-Reliability For Cloud Robotics
reported_metric: up to 3.7x lower P99 latency vs single provider
tldr: Formulates an impossibility triangle for latency reliability and sends each request over several network interfaces to replicated cloud servers, taking the first answer to cut deadline misses.
relevance_reason: Tail-latency reliability for cloud-offloaded robot compute.

title: A Survey on Deep Neural Network Partition over Cloud, Edge and End Devices
tldr: Survey with a unified model and five-axis taxonomy (locations, granularity, constraints, objectives, algorithms) of DNN partitioning across cloud, edge and device.
relevance_reason: General split-computing background that VLA partitioning papers build on.

title: Split Computing and Early Exiting for Deep Learning Applications: Survey and Research Challenges
tldr: Canonical survey of splitting DNNs between mobile device and edge server and of early-exit models, covering bottleneck design and open challenges.
relevance_reason: Foundational split-computing reference for robot edge-cloud inference.

title: Dynamic Split Computing for Efficient Deep Edge Intelligence
tldr: Chooses the DNN split location at runtime according to channel data rate and server load, using natural bottleneck layers so no retraining is required.
relevance_reason: Generic dynamic split computing, precursor to network-aware VLA splitting.

title: AsyncVLA: An Asynchronous VLA for Fast and Robust Navigation on the Edge
reported_metric: 40% higher success than baselines with delays up to 6 s
tldr: Runs a large navigation foundation model on a remote workstation for guidance while a small onboard adapter refines actions at high rate, trained end-to-end to tolerate multi-second delays.
relevance_reason: Canonical remote-VLA plus onboard-adapter hierarchy (Levine group).

title: AsyncShield: A Plug-and-Play Edge Adapter for Asynchronous Cloud-based VLA Navigation
tldr: Plug-and-play edge module that converts cloud-VLA latency into pose offsets using a pose buffer and a constrained RL adapter balancing VLA intent against LiDAR obstacle avoidance.
relevance_reason: Edge-side safety/latency compensation for cloud VLA.

title: Hybrid Visual Telemetry for Bandwidth-Constrained Robotic Vision: A Pilot Study with HEVC Base Video and JPEG ROI Stills
tldr: Pilot study splitting a fixed uplink budget between low-bitrate video and selectively sent high-detail ROI stills for robotic/UAV perception.
relevance_reason: Bandwidth-aware transport for remote robot perception.

title: Robotic Foundation Models for Industrial Control: A Comprehensive Survey and Readiness Assessment Framework
tldr: Survey and 149-criterion readiness framework rating 324 manipulation foundation models for industry, including edge-compute and real-time requirements.
relevance_reason: Deployability/edge constraints of RFMs in factories.

title: PhyAI: Real-Time Physical AI at the Edge, Scalable Rollouts in the Cloud
base_model: pi0, pi0.5, GR00T N1.7, MiniCPM-Robot, Cosmos3-Nano-Policy
reported_metric: 1.40-4.65x speedup over official implementations; Cosmos3-Nano-Policy latency 2.46 s -> 1.18 s on 8x H20; pi0.5 ~100 samples/s at batch 32
tldr: One inference runtime for VLAs and world-action models that runs the same checkpoint onboard, on edge servers and for cloud RL rollouts, with profiling showing batch-size-dependent bottlenecks and a control-time roofline.
relevance_reason: Unifies onboard/edge/cloud serving of robot policies with batching/throughput analysis.

title: Kairos: A Scalable Serving System for Physical AI
reported_metric: 31.8-66.5% lower average end-to-end task latency vs digital-AI serving practices
tldr: Kairos is a multi-robot serving system that schedules inference with awareness of each robot's chunk execution phase, cutting task latency as fleets grow.
relevance_reason: Fleet-scale serving treating the generate-execute loop as first-class (Microsoft Research).

title: VLA-RAIL: A Real-Time Asynchronous Inference Linker for VLA Models and Robots
tldr: Middleware between VLA server and robot that runs inference asynchronously, smooths each chunk by polynomial fitting and fuses successive chunks with position/velocity/acceleration continuity.
relevance_reason: Deployment middleware for async (possibly remote) VLA serving.

title: ActionFlow: A Pipelined Action Acceleration for Vision Language Models on Edge
reported_metric: 2.55x FPS improvement on OpenVLA-7B
tldr: Treats consecutive VLA timesteps as micro-requests and batches memory-bound decode with compute-bound prefill across them to raise edge-device utilization.
relevance_reason: Onboard serving-system alternative to offloading.

title: RAPAC-DP: Response-Aligned Pending-Action Compensation for Diffusion Policies under Delayed Execution
reported_metric: retains 81.4% of delay-free performance at largest Kinetix delay
tldr: Adds a small pathway conditioned on actions already queued before a cloud reply arrives, letting a frozen diffusion/flow policy compensate for communication and compute delay.
relevance_reason: Explicitly targets cloud-deployed policies under delay.

title: DAG-Based QoS-Aware Dynamic Task Placement for Networked Multi-Stage Control Pipelines
tldr: Models perception-planning-control pipelines as a DAG and switches stages among local, offloaded and hybrid placements using a tail-latency/deadline/utilization cost with switching penalties.
relevance_reason: Placement framework for networked robot control pipelines (theoretical).

title: ORICF -- Open Robotics Inference and Control Framework
reported_metric: up to 83.16% lower robot-side compute utilization and 65.8% lower estimated energy vs onboard
tldr: YAML-configured ROS 2 framework composing multimodal inference pipelines that can be moved from the robot to nearby edge computers without code changes.
relevance_reason: Edge offloading tooling with energy measurements.

title: vAccSOL: Efficient and Transparent AI Vision Offloading for Mobile Robots
reported_metric: up to 80% lower robot-side power and up to 24x higher vision pipeline frame rate
tldr: Compiler plus lightweight runtime that transparently runs vision models on the robot or dispatches them to nearby edge servers, cutting robot power and raising frame rates.
relevance_reason: Transparent edge offloading for mobile robots.

title: Supercomputing for High-speed Avoidance and Reactive Planning in Robots
hardware: local and remote (~300 km) HPC clusters
reported_metric: mean planning latency 22.9 ms local / 30.0 ms remote
tldr: Proof of concept showing a remote HPC cluster can plan projectile-avoidance motions for a 7-DOF arm within tens of milliseconds, motivating onboard reflexes plus offloaded bursty planning.
relevance_reason: Quantifies when remote compute suffices for reactive control.

title: Opportunistic Collaborative Planning with Large Vision Model Guided Control and Joint Query-Service Optimization
tldr: Local MPC navigation is guided by a cloud large vision model that is queried only when detection confidence is low, jointly optimizing when to ask the cloud.
relevance_reason: When-to-query-cloud policy for hybrid local/cloud control.

title: ConfigBot: Adaptive Resource Allocation for Robot Applications in Dynamic Environments
tldr: Adaptively reconfigures onboard robot software stacks via runtime profiling to meet performance specifications instead of static over-provisioning.
relevance_reason: Onboard compute management; tangential.

title: PEERNet: An End-to-End Profiling Tool for Real-Time Networked Robotic Systems
tldr: Real-time profiler for networked robot systems measuring sensors, network, model latency and devices to inform when to offload, e.g., VLM queries from a Jetson Orin.
relevance_reason: Measurement tooling for offloading decisions.

title: CloudGripper: An Open Source Cloud Robotics Testbed for Robotic Manipulation Research, Benchmarking and Data Collection at Scale
hardware: rack of 32 low-cost arms, 10 Gbit/s network
tldr: Rack of 32 enclosed low-cost robot arm cells with high-bandwidth networking, built as a community testbed for remote, cloud-connected manipulation experiments and data collection.
relevance_reason: Infrastructure for studying cloud/edge robot learning at scale.

title: RoboKube: Establishing a New Foundation for the Cloud Native Evolution in Robotics
tldr: Reviews cloudification practice in robotics and proposes a Kubernetes-based platform for deploying ROS applications across the device-cloud continuum.
relevance_reason: Fleet deployment infrastructure.

title: RobotKube: Orchestrating Large-Scale Cooperative Multi-Robot Systems with Kubernetes and ROS
tldr: Automates orchestration of containerized ROS microservices across robots and infrastructure for large cooperative multi-robot systems.
relevance_reason: Fleet software orchestration.

title: Edge Accelerated Robot Navigation With Collaborative Motion Planning
tldr: Robots switch between a safe local planner and an aggressive edge-offloaded planner, choosing via model predictive switching under compute and communication constraints.
relevance_reason: Principled local-vs-edge switching for robot control.

title: Deployment Is Not Destiny: Robot Recomposition in the Field with Unseen Software, Hardware, and Compute Payloads
tldr: Framework letting fielded robots integrate new software, hardware and compute payloads at runtime and share them with peers, so constrained robots can use new remote compute.
relevance_reason: Fleet-level compute sharing.

title: CSAR: Containerized System Architecture for Robotics
tldr: Container-centric architecture for robotics teams spanning embedded devices, edge servers and cloud with ROS 2/DDS networking.
relevance_reason: Edge-cloud deployment infrastructure.

title: React When You Need To: Event-Triggered Asynchronous Inference for VLA Policies
reported_metric: 95% average success, +55 pp over strongest baseline
tldr: Triggers the next asynchronous VLA inference based on observed scene change rather than a fixed gap, balancing smoothness and reactivity.
relevance_reason: Adaptive inference-call scheduling reduces compute/network calls.

title: Action ControlNet: A Lightweight Delay-Aware Adapter for Smooth Asynchronous Control in Vision-Language-Action Models
tldr: Small adapter conditions a mostly frozen action head on the already-executed motion suffix to remove chunk-handoff jitter under asynchronous execution.
relevance_reason: Async-inference smoothing technique.

title: Acting While Understanding: Asynchronous Semantic-Action Decoupling for Real-Time Vision-Language-Action Models
tldr: Splits an existing VLA at its semantic-action interface so a slow understanding module updates reusable conditions while a fast action module runs continuously.
relevance_reason: Slow/fast split that maps naturally onto cloud/edge partitioning.

title: Delay-Aware Diffusion Policy: Bridging the Observation-Execution Gap in Dynamic Tasks
tldr: Trains diffusion policies with measured inference delay as input and delay-corrected targets so they stay accurate when observations are stale.
relevance_reason: Delay-robust policy learning relevant to offloaded inference.

title: World Action Models in Real Time: An Empirical Study of Smooth Execution via Asynchronous Deployment
tldr: Compares six asynchronous deployment strategies for world action models on a bimanual robot and finds precise temporal alignment of observations, predictions and commands is essential.
relevance_reason: Deployment study of latency hiding for WAMs.

title: Reactive Real-Time Flow Policies via Asynchronous Distribution Alignment
tldr: Shows asynchronous execution can shift a VLA's action distribution for non-Markovian demos and restores reactivity by distilling the async policy toward the original.
relevance_reason: Async-inference correctness.

title: Start Right, Arrive Right: Asynchronous Execution via Initial Noise Selection
tldr: PAINT picks the flow policy's initial noise via backward inversion so the unmodified ODE continues the executed prefix, making async chunking consistent without steering.
relevance_reason: Training-free async execution technique.

title: F2F-AP: Flow-to-Future Asynchronous Policy for Real-time Dynamic Manipulation
tldr: Synthesizes future observations from predicted object flow so an asynchronous policy acts on where the scene will be, improving dynamic manipulation under latency.
relevance_reason: Latency compensation for async policies.

title: LAGO Policy: Latency-Aware Asynchronous Diffusion Policies with Goal-Directed Collision-Free Planning for Smooth Manipulation
tldr: Asynchronous diffusion policy using latency-aware guidance on future actions plus trajectory optimization for smooth, collision-free execution.
relevance_reason: Async execution smoothness/safety.

title: FogROS: An Adaptive Framework for Automating Fog Robotics Deployment
reported_metric: compute speedups 2.6x (ORB-SLAM2), 6.0x (Dex-Net), 34.2x (motion planning) with added network latency 1.2 s / 0.6 s / 0.5 s
tldr: Original FogROS: lets developers mark ROS components to run on specified cloud hardware, trading network latency for large compute speedups.
relevance_reason: Seed predecessor of FogROS2.

title: A Fog Robotics Approach to Deep Robot Learning: Application to Object Recognition and Grasp Planning in Surface Decluttering
tldr: Trains deep models on synthetic data in the cloud, adapts them at a trusted edge on private real images, and serves low-latency inference to robots on the local network.
relevance_reason: Seminal fog-robotics deep-learning paper.

title: Edge-Cloud Collaborative Motion Planning for Autonomous Driving with Large Language Models
tldr: EC-Drive runs small LLMs at the vehicle edge and uploads only drift-flagged data to a cloud LLM for motion planning, reducing latency and cloud traffic.
relevance_reason: Selective edge-to-cloud escalation for embodied planning.

title: Collaborative Inference and Learning between Edge SLMs and Cloud LLMs: A Survey of Algorithms, Execution, and Open Challenges
tldr: Survey and taxonomy of edge-small-model / cloud-large-model collaboration for both inference and training.
relevance_reason: Generic LLM edge-cloud collaboration that robot systems borrow from.

title: Advancing Multi-Robot Networks via MLLM-Driven Sensing, Communication, and Computation: A Comprehensive Survey
tldr: Survey on how multimodal LLMs interplay with sensing, communication and computation in multi-robot networks, including cloud-based orchestrators and bandwidth limits.
relevance_reason: Survey covering fleet-level communication/compute trade-offs.

title: Helix: A Vision-Language-Action Model for Generalist Humanoid Control
reported_metric: S2 at 7-9 Hz, S1 at 200 Hz
tldr: Figure's humanoid VLA splits a 7B VLM running at 7-9 Hz from an 80M policy at 200 Hz, both entirely on onboard embedded GPUs - an industry example of choosing onboard over cloud.
relevance_reason: Canonical onboard hierarchical design, counterpoint to cloud offloading.

title: ComVLA: Communication-Aware Split Inference for VLA Models in 6G-Connected Robotics
reported_metric: 32 vs 512 tokens: 74% less inference compute, 22% lower latency, 95.4% vs 96.9% LIBERO success
tldr: Uses the language instruction to choose which visual tokens to send over a wireless link to a cloud VLA, matching the token budget to instantaneous channel capacity.
relevance_reason: Bandwidth-aware split inference co-designed with the wireless channel for VLAs.

title: Task-Oriented Communication for Human Action Understanding via Edge-Cloud Co-Inference
reported_metric: payload ~1% and latency ~20% of video-codec baselines
tldr: Edge extracts pose and sends compact VQ-VAE motion tokens (as low as 9 bits/frame) to a cloud VLM for human action understanding.
relevance_reason: Task-oriented edge-cloud transport pattern relevant to robot perception offload.

title: Task-Oriented Edge-Assisted Cooperative Data Compression, Communications and Computing for UGV-Enhanced Warehouse Logistics
tldr: Offloads navigation/following control of two cooperating warehouse UGVs to an edge server and uses DRL to adapt point-cloud compression ratios to task needs.
relevance_reason: Bandwidth/compute co-design for offloaded robot control.

title: When Robots Exchange Meaning: A Demo of Goal-Oriented Semantic Communications for Collaborative Robotics
hardware: mobile robot + Jetson Orin edge node
reported_metric: 42.67x payload reduction vs model-input RGB bytes
